An umbrella term for methods that train only a small subset of model parameters or a small set of added parameters instead of all parameters. This can greatly reduce GPU memory and storage requirements. LoRA is a representative example.

A method that saves memory by quantizing base-model weights to, for example, 4 bits, then trains with LoRA. This lets smaller GPUs handle larger models.
